sloka: सुमागधी नदी रम्या मागधान् विश्रुता आययौ ।पंचानाम् शैल मुख्यानाम् मध्ये माला इव शोभते ॥१-३२-९॥
transliteration: sumāgadhī nadī ramyā māgadhān viśrutā āyayau ।paṁcānām śaila mukhyānām madhye mālā iva śobhate ॥1-32-9॥

translations.english: The delightful and renowned river Sumagadhi (known as Sona), flowing in the country of Magadha, looks beautiful like a garland amidst five great mountains.
